title: On-chain Details Intent Study

official_window.stopping_rule: 20 distinct page_view sessions in EACH variant OR 14 days, whichever occurs first

interpretation.conclusion: No on-chain detail clicks were observed in either variant.
limitations: The planned threshold of 20 distinct page_view sessions per variant was not reached.
No causal superiority, inferiority, or equivalence claim is supported.
Secondary engagement differences are descriptive only and should not be interpreted as statistically reliable.

semantic_scope.onchain_click_means: Intent to inspect on-chain details only

evidence_note: Final counts were obtained from the remote Cloudflare D1 query output supplied at experiment close and independently arithmetic-checked before archival.
